title: Fema / RBI | RBI Issues Draft RCB Concentration Risk & Credit Facility Directions for Comments
description: Fema / RBIRBI has issued draft RCB concentration risk and credit facility directions proposing revised exposure limits, housing loan norms and credit rules from 1 April 2027.The post RBI Issues Draft RCB Concentration Risk & Credit Facility Directions for Comments appeared first on TaxGuru.
